name: students_not_assign_external_grades_disjointness
rationale: The specification explicitly forbids students from assigning external grades. This safety property prevents a candidate policy from permitting assignExternalGrade requests where the user is a member of Student, even if other roles might otherwise grant assignment permissions.
plain_english_summary: Students must not be permitted to assign external grades.
source_excerpt: Students receive external grades but must not assign external grades; There do not exist members of Student who can Assign ExternalGrades.
reference_cedar: permit (principal, action == Action::"assignExternalGrade", resource) when { !(principal in Student::"Student") && resource is ExternalGrade };

name: faculty_assign_internal_grades_floor
rationale: The specification explicitly states that faculty members can assign internal grades and that such requests will succeed. A floor is required so synthesis cannot satisfy the specification with only denials or unrelated permissions.
plain_english_summary: Faculty members must be permitted to assign internal grades.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades; Requests for ... faculty to Assign ... InternalGrades ... will succeed.
reference_cedar: permit (principal, action == Action::"assignInternalGrade", resource) when { principal in Faculty::"Faculty" && resource is InternalGrade };

name: faculty_assign_external_grades_floor
rationale: The specification explicitly requires successful faculty assignment of external grades. Because already-approved safety properties forbid students from assigning external grades, and the spec also forbids any combination of roles that both receives and assigns external grades, this floor is scoped to faculty users who are not also in receiving-only roles exposed by the schema.
plain_english_summary: Faculty members who are not students or Faculty Family members must be permitted to assign external grades.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades; Requests for ... faculty to Assign ... ExternalGrades ... will succeed.
reference_cedar: permit (principal, action == Action::"assignExternalGrade", resource) when { principal in Faculty::"Faculty" && !(principal in Student::"Student") && !(principal in FacultyFamily::"FacultyFamily") && resource is ExternalGrade };

examples_adversarial.description: A user who is both Faculty and Student requests to assign an external grade. A broad faculty-only floor would require permitting this, conflicting with the approved student external-grade assignment prohibition.

alternatives_considered.label: broad_faculty_external_assignment
alternatives_considered.interpretive_choice: Permit every faculty member to assign external grades without accounting for overlapping Student or FacultyFamily membership.
alternatives_considered.cedar_text: permit (principal, action == Action::"assignExternalGrade", resource) when { principal in Faculty::"Faculty" && resource is ExternalGrade };

This repaired floor scopes the required successful faculty case to faculty users who are not in any schema role named by those conflicting external-grade assignment or receive boundaries.

source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades; Requests for ... faculty to Assign ... ExternalGrades ... will succeed; Teaching assistants must not ... assign external grades; Faculty Family can receive External-Grades.

name: external_grades_assigned_only_by_faculty_ceiling
rationale: The approved floors require a non-conflicting faculty member to be able to assign external grades, and the approved disjointness atoms exclude students, teaching assistants, and Faculty Family members. A remaining safety boundary is that external-grade assignment is tied to faculty responsibility; without this ceiling, a user in none of the forbidden roles and not in Faculty could still be permitted to assign external grades, contrary to the faculty-responsibility wording.
